CORRECTION to the previous note (operator-flagged confabulation): the claim that a fleet.json project_dispatch.env change (CARGO_INCREMENTAL=0) would fix lane-pool sccache bypass was WRONG on two counts and was never applied. (1) fleet.json project_dispatch is the TUI/daemon dispatch surface; it does not govern lane-pod build env, which is provisioned by the cage infrastructure (bbox-cage lane provisioning). Any incremental-vs-sccache fix for lanes belongs there, and the actual delivery path should be read before proposing again. (2) No daemon-side config touches in-harness/interactive agents (Claude sessions, their subagents, local Bash builds) - the population that actually produced the 1.9M-entry target/debug/deps. Their build env comes from the interactive shell plus .cargo/config.toml (wrapper slot held by the cold guard); the honest local fix is periodic target/debug pruning, since incremental-on is the right tradeoff for interactive loops. Note gap-8c0457ba's own proposed fix surface ("project_dispatch env ... should set CARGO_INCREMENTAL=0") carries the same unverified frame and should be re-grounded against real lane env wiring before being acted on. Surviving fact: incremental compilation does bypass sccache, so pods running incremental-on get little from sccache - fix surface is lane provisioning.
